name: Vial of mysterious black substance
summary: A strange vial filled with swirling black goo. In constant movement, it seems to have a mind of its own.

name: Dark Shard Amulet
summary: A heavy, aged bronze amulet featuring a swirling, trapped galaxy of indigo and green.It hums with a faint, cosmic pulse, and a drift of purple smoke sometimes reveals shifting runes.

name: Book of city sewer maps
summary: An old leather tome containing various schematics and blueprints for the ancient sewer system

name: Strange Token
summary: A small wooden token circled with an exotic metal, featuring three roughly made claw marks.

name: Potion of Healing
summary: The warm red liquid is bitter sweet, familiar yet always surprising.

name: Meditations on the Way of the Lizard (Book)
